name: Robe of the Overflowing Spirit, Water
body:
Price 6,000 gp; Aura faint conjuration; CL 3rd; Slot body; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This robe shines with a vibrant blue sheen, its cloth constantly moving and flowing, even when there is no air to jostle it.

The wearer gains a +1 morale bonus on Fortitude saves. Wearers with the spirit ability can access additional powers when they gain spirit in excess of their normal maximum capacity. When this happens, the robe consumes the extra spirit points, and the wearer may activate the ability as a free action, otherwise the points are wasted. For every point of spirit consumed, the robe restores a number of hit points equal to the number of class levels that the wearer possesses in the class that grants them the Spirit ability.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 3,000 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells cure moderate wounds
